one_line: Ahom king Rajeswar Singha and his chief palace architect overseeing the Talatal Ghar at Rangpur.

appearance.age_look: Rajeswar Singha appears in his late 30s, tall and firmly built; the Chang-Rung Phukan appears in his early 40s, slightly leaner but sturdy.
appearance.face: Rajeswar has an oval face, medium-brown Assamese complexion, sharp nose, defined jaw, thin moustache and short trimmed beard; his default expression is calm but commanding with focused eyes. The Chang-Rung Phukan has a slightly broader face, medium-brown complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache, faint stubble, and a thoughtful, observant expression that often looks sideways as if checking construction lines.
appearance.hair: Rajeswar’s black hair is oiled, drawn back into a tight topknot at the crown and wrapped with a narrow white cloth band with a thin red edge; the Chang-Rung Phukan’s black hair is similarly pulled back into a smaller knot, tied with a plain off-white cloth strip, with a few short strands at the temples.
appearance.costume: Rajeswar wears an Ahom royal-style outfit: a long-sleeved, knee-length cotton tunic (jama) in rich deep maroon with a subtle woven pattern, side-tied with matching fabric cords, over a cream-coloured, ankle-length dhoti tightly wrapped and pleated in front; around his shoulders is a soft off-white eri silk gamosa-like shawl with a red woven border and minimal geometric motifs, draped over the left shoulder and under the right arm. He has a narrow gold waist-belt, simple gold bangles, and a single small gold earring in each ear; his footwear is brown leather sandals with simple straps. The Chang-Rung Phukan wears a simpler version: a pale indigo, long-sleeved, hip-length cotton tunic with side ties, a plain unbleached cotton dhoti tied just above the ankles, and a light beige cotton shawl with a thin blue border folded and slung diagonally across his torso to free his hands; he has a simple braided cotton waist-cord, no jewellery except a small copper earring in one ear, and dark brown leather sandals.
appearance.signature: Rajeswar Singha carries a sheathed straight ceremonial dao (Assamese sword) with a simple brass hilt and plain brown scabbard hanging from his left side by a leather strap, while the Chang-Rung Phukan holds a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a thin cord in one hand and a slender wooden measuring rod tucked under his arm.

ref_desc: Rajeswar Singha is a tall medium-brown Assamese king with a topknot wrapped in a white band, maroon knee-length tunic, cream dhoti, off-white red-bordered shawl, gold belt and a sheathed straight dao, beside the lean Chang-Rung Phukan in indigo tunic, plain dhoti, beige shawl, carrying a palm-leaf manuscript and wooden measuring rod, all in maroon, cream, off-white, indigo and brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet showing two fixed characters together: first, Rajeswar Singha, a tall medium-brown Assamese king with an oval face, thin moustache and short trimmed beard, black hair oiled into a tight topknot wrapped by a narrow white band with a red edge; he wears a long-sleeved, knee-length deep maroon cotton tunic with side ties, a cream ankle-length dhoti neatly pleated in front, an off-white eri silk gamosa-like shawl with a red woven border draped over his left shoulder and under his right arm, a narrow gold waist-belt, simple gold bangles, small gold earrings, and brown leather sandals, carrying at his left side a sheathed straight ceremonial dao with a brass hilt and plain brown scabbard. Beside him stands the Chang-Rung Phukan, slightly shorter and lean, medium-brown, with a broader face, neat moustache, faint stubble, black hair pulled into a small knot tied with an off-white strip; he wears a pale indigo long-sleeved hip-length cotton tunic with side ties, an unbleached cotton dhoti to the ankles, a light beige shawl with a thin blue border slung diagonally across his torso, a braided cotton waist-cord, a small copper earring, and dark brown leather sandals, holding a rolled palm-leaf manuscript in one hand and tucking a slender wooden measuring rod under his arm; use a consistent palette of deep maroon, cream, off-white, indigo and brown leather, and pose them before a faint suggestion of brick-vaulted Ahom palace architecture without cluttering the view of their full outfits.
